name: radMLBench
description: A collection of radiomics datasets assembled to enable standardized benchmarking of machine learning methods for radiomic feature analysis and predictive modeling.
reputation: An emerging standardized collection in the radiomics community for benchmarking predictive modeling methods, used increasingly in academic studies.
notes: Heterogeneous, often small cohorts with scanner/site confounders and risk of label leakage; non-LLM benchmark focused on classical ML/deep learning for medical imaging features.
